high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the verified user @charlidamelio. The post features a person standing in front of a house that has been decorated to resemble the iconic Beetlejuice house from the movie of the same name. Setting: The house is a two-story structure with a steeply pitched roof and a prominent steeple. The exterior walls are covered with black netting, giving it a ghostly appearance. The house has a red door with white trim and a small porch with white railings. The landscaping includes some shrubs
